'''Dominique de Caen''' ({{Birth date|1956|5|11}} – {{Death date|2002|6|25}}) was a mathematician, Doctor of Mathematics, and professor of mathematics, who specialized in [[graph theory]], [[probability theory]], and [[information theory]]. He is renowned for his research on [[Pál Turán|Turán's]] extremal problem for [[hypergraph]]s.<ref name=dom>{{cite journal |title=The combinatorics of Dom de Caen  |last=Van Dam |first=Edwin R.  |journal=Designs, Codes and Cryptography  |volume=34  |issue=2  |pages=137–148  |year=2005  |url=https://pure.uvt.nl/portal/en/publications/the-combinatorics-of-dom-de-caen%283b0c4635-bbfa-4dab-b4e5-383fb3665ab9%29.html |doi=10.1007/s10623-004-4850-y|s2cid=161220 }}</ref><ref name=qu>{{cite web |title= Dominique de Caen (1956-2002) |publisher= Queen's University at Kingston Department of Mathematics and Statistics |url= http://www.mast.queensu.ca/~gregoryd/decaen/ |accessdate= November 7, 2012 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20130126050243/http://www.mast.queensu.ca/~gregoryd/decaen/ |archive-date= January 26, 2013 |url-status= dead }}</ref>

==Career==

He studied mathematics at [[McGill University]], where he earned a Bachelor of Science degree in 1977.<ref name=dom/>

In 1979, he obtained a Master of Science degree from [[Queen's University at Kingston|Queen's University]] with a thesis on [[Logical matrix|Prime Boolean]] matrices.<ref name=dom/>

In 1982, he earned the Doctorate of Mathematics degree from [[University of Toronto]] with a thesis entitled ''On Turán's Hypergraph Problem'' which was supervised by [[Eric Mendelsohn (mathematician)|Eric Mendelsohn]].<ref name=dom/><ref>{{MathGenealogy|15978}}</ref>

Most of his academic papers have been published in the journals ''[[Discrete Mathematics (journal)|Discrete Mathematics]]'', ''Designs, Codes and Cryptography'', the ''[[Journal of Combinatorial Theory]]'', and the ''[[European Journal of Combinatorics]]'', among others.<ref name=qu/><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.informatik.uni-trier.de/~ley/db/indices/a-tree/c/Caen:Dominique_de.html |publisher= The Leibniz-Zentrum für Informatik |title= Dominique de Caen Bibliographic Database |accessdate = 7 November 2012}}</ref>
